name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectiveText: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.

comments.body: The Explosive Barrel is At Coordinates 50,14

Does the reward seem a little weak for the end of this line of quests?

While killing the Ogres for the gem I got a better weapon drop then the ultimate reward choices.

Sad.
replies: I mean, the two handed axe is good and all, but I expected something a little bigger.  But it was 1950 xp, plus 150 reputation with IF.

comments.body: Bad rewards if you do the quest on lvl 20+ , on lvl 20 you already must visested deadmines to get cruel barb :P
replies: Bad maybe to use, but I won't turn down 17s.

yeah thanks a bunch everone, you guys rock!
Killed about 20 ogres, then killed Emogg the Crusher and he dropped it. I hear other people have had better luck getting the crystal off him
